status: painted keyframe targets, not physical measurements

units.weights: normalized art-directed contributions; NOT Three.js intensity or lux
units.fog: relative outdoor visual density, not engine weather state

interpolation: Use existing sun trajectory; cyclic time interpolation of art weights with no discontinuity. Do not alter simulation time.

interior.day: window-driven directional light plus modest bounce
interior.night: actual milk-glass ceiling lamps / bedside lamps
interior.cutaway: retain architectural light blocking and visible floors/contents
interior.fog: use current interior exclusion; preserve object readability

psychological.region: peripheral scene only; no UI distortion
psychological.reducedMotion: static mild tint or off; user strength 0 disables
